# `aitbc trade create`

Create a new inter-chain trade between source and destination chains.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc trade create [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--source-chain` | text | — | yes | Source chain ID |
| `--dest-chain` | text | — | yes | Destination chain ID |
| `--sender` | text | — | yes | Sender address (source chain) |
| `--recipient` | text | — | yes | Recipient address (dest chain) |
| `--amount` | integer | — | yes | Amount to trade |
| `--offer-id` | text | — | no | Associated offer ID |
| `--price` | float | `0.0` | no | Trade price |
| `--quantity` | integer | `0` | no | Trade quantity |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc trade create --source-chain <source_chain> --dest-chain <dest_chain> --sender <sender> --recipient <recipient> --amount <amount>
```
